_doc: Auction houses (AUC-001, Auctions). Each house in `region` (regions.json id) holds an auction every period_days days, first at offset_days after the game starts, lasting open_days days. Each auction draws `lots` distinct entries from lot_table by weight. Lot entry: item (items.json id), count (default 1), base_price (spirit stones, the opening bid), weight (> 0), rarity (one of Auctions.RARITIES, for display). `bidders` NPC bidders each roll a hidden maximum of base_price * a random factor in bid_spread [low, high]; the lot's NPC max is the highest of them (0 bidders = no competition). The player places one sealed bid per lot (at least base_price): above the NPC max wins and pays the bid, otherwise a rival takes the lot. Lots are rolled from the world seed, so an auction's lots are fixed once it opens.

houses.name: Fallen Star Auction House
houses.description: Every season the Myriad Treasure Pavilion auctions relics, pills and manuals dug from ruins across the realm.
